【最终自然语言假设 / Final natural-language hypothesis】

Between 3400 and 3000 BCE, the number of monuments and the abundance of axes/celts moved in close lockstep and followed a shared hump-shaped trajectory that was INVERSELY coupled to the trajectory of symbolic-capital elements. Both series started low at 3400 BCE (ZMonument = -0.46, ZBeil/AxesCelts = +0.37), rose to a pronounced joint peak at 3200 BCE (ZMonument = +0.91, ZBeil = +2.60), and fell back by 3000 BCE (ZMonument = -0.36, ZBeil = +0.80). Their synchrony is high at every time scale (annual interpolated series r = +0.93; the 5 century anchor observations r = +0.87; year-over-year changes r = +0.82), with the lead/lag profile peaking at lag 0 — monuments and axes rose and fell together, with no evidence that one led the other (the symmetric decay around lag 0 is largely an artifact of linear interpolation between century points).

Against the symbolic-capital elements the pattern is decoupled-to-inverse: hatchet/sword values stayed essentially flat (-0.43 to -0.42, giving only a weak descriptive positive co-movement with monuments, r ≈ +0.28, and near-zero with axes, r ≈ +0.03); dagger values were strictly constant (-0.58) throughout the window and therefore carry no within-window covariation; and house size — the only symbolic-capital element with substantial variance — declined steadily (z = +2.05 → +0.19, ≈ -0.45 z per century), co-varying negatively with monuments (levels r = -0.40; century-step changes r = -0.04, descriptive) and with axes (levels r = -0.26; century-step changes r = +0.50, descriptive, sign unstable across scales). Against the demographic background, pollen-based landscape openness (MEAN PC1) declined through the window (≈ -0.63 z/century) and shows weak negative level associations with monuments (r = -0.09) and axes (r = -0.19), while monument counts align positively with short-term phases of pollen increase (pollen growth rate r = +0.36, Spearman +0.41).

HYPOTHESIS: Around 3200 BCE the region experienced a joint surge in monument construction and axe/celt production that was not accompanied — and in the case of house size, was inversely accompanied — by increases in the classic symbolic-capital markers (personal prestige goods such as hatchets/swords and daggers, and large houses). Monument building (social capital) and axe production (economic capital) appear to have acted as alternative, collectively oriented displays of wealth and organization that substituted for, rather than tracked, household-level symbolic capital, and this surge unfolded during a phase of declining landscape openness (contracting rather than expanding land-use intensity), with monument activity most intense in episodes when openness was temporarily increasing. The 3200 BCE single-point peak must be read cautiously: only five century-spaced observations underlie the entire window, and the peak may be inflated by counting conventions or preservation bias.

【中文要点】公元前3400–3000年间，纪念碑数量与斧/锛类数量高度同步（r≈+0.87~+0.93，无领先-滞后关系），共同在公元前3200年前后达到峰值后回落；而象征资本三要素在此期间并未同步上升——钺/剑几乎不变（z≈-0.43）、短剑完全恒定（-0.58，窗口内无方差）、房屋规模持续下降（+2.05→+0.19，约-0.45 z/百年）。纪念碑与斧/锛同房屋规模呈负向共变（水平值 r≈-0.40/-0.26），与花粉开放度呈弱负相关（开放度本身在该窗口下降约0.63 z/百年），但纪念碑活动与花粉的短期上升相位正相关（r≈+0.36）。结论（假设）：纪念碑（社会资本）与斧/锛（经济资本）的激增是对停滞/收缩的 household 象征资本的替代性集体展示，且发生在景观开放度下降的背景中，而非人口扩张驱动。

【Workflow 简述】(1) 加载并核对三份数据：CE/calBP 换算（calBP = 1950 - CE，全文件零偏差）、窗口 CE -3400…-3000（401 年行）与 capital.csv 的 5 个百年整点完全一致；(2) 以 _inter 逐年序列刻画窗口内 MonumentCount、AxesCelts 及三要素与花粉指标的趋势（OLS 斜率/百年）；(3) (a) 分别计算 MonumentCount、AxesCelts 与 HatchetSword、Dagger、HouseSize 的共变（年序列水平值 + 有效自由度校正 + 一阶差分 + 百年整点 n=5 与百年增量 n=4 的描述性相关）；(b) MonumentCount–AxesCelts 的同期与 ±100 年 lead/lag 剖面，并做剔除 -3200 峰值期的敏感性检验（r 从 0.93 降至 0.83，关系稳健）；(c) 与花粉开放度 MEAN / SMOOTH_MEAN_100y / pollen_grate_100 的相关；(4) PC1 方向检验：PC1 全期向晚近上升（+1.66 z/千年，r=0.87），窗口内与 HouseSize 正相关（r=+0.67）、与 Belau 花粉序列 r=+0.93，支持"PC1 越高越开放"的惯例假设；(5) 构建象征资本合成指标（三要素均值 z）做交叉验证（MonumentCount r=-0.40、AxesCelts r=-0.26）。全部检验按 lag-1 自相关的有效自由度校正；因线性插值导致 n_eff 退化为 3–13，所有 p 值仅作参考，结论以方向性和多尺度一致性为准。
